# Mithil Girish

> Software Engineer & Data Scientist | Edge AI, Context Engines, and Distributed Systems

Full context document available at: https://www.mithilgirish.dev/llms-full.txt

## Summary
Mithil Girish is a Software Engineer and Data Scientist based in Chennai, India. Currently pursuing a B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science) at Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT Chennai, 2023–2027). He is an SDE Intern at FinkAI, co-founder of Channelise, and an active open-source contributor to Apache Iceberg Go. Recognized as an Amazon ML Summer School 2026 Scholar and an Economic Times AI Hackathon 2.0 Finalist.

## Current Roles & Work History
- **SDE Intern @ FinkAI** (Dec 2024 – Present): Architecting distributed backend services, high-throughput data pipelines, and low-latency LLM agent runtime engines.
- **Project Intern @ ANNAM.AI** (Aug 2024 – Nov 2024): Conducted applied research in computer vision, deep learning inference optimization, and automated model distillation.
- **Project Intern @ Indira Gandhi Centre for Atomic Research (IGCAR), DAE** (Jun 2024 – Jul 2024): Designed data acquisition tools, telemetry ingestion pipelines, and scientific computing automation for reactor physics simulations.
- **Co-Founder @ Channelise** (May 2024 – Present): Built a collaborative platform connecting YouTube creators, video editors, and thumbnail artists. Engineered with Next.js, Supabase, and real-time websockets.

## Honors & Certifications
- **Amazon ML Summer School 2026 Scholar**: Selected among thousands of applicants across India for intensive supervised machine learning, deep learning, LLMs, and distributed training systems.
- **Economic Times AI Hackathon 2.0 Finalist**: Ranked in the top echelon nationally for developing an autonomous multi-agent financial intelligence workflow.

## Key Projects
- **traz**: High-performance contextual memory engine. Combines a Rust-native AST parsing and SIMD-accelerated vector quantization core with a Go daemon orchestrating fast context extraction and indexing.
- **Apache Iceberg Go**: Open-source contributions to the official Go implementation of Apache Iceberg, delivering table metadata parsers, partition spec validation, and REST catalog client optimizations.
- **PACTUS**: Distributed microservices framework incorporating Hedera Hashgraph for tamper-proof audit trails, consensus verification, and real-time event streaming.
- **AgroFlow**: Precision agricultural intelligence system combining edge computer vision (YOLO-World) with microclimate sensor telemetry for plant health diagnostics and yield prediction.
- **Channelise**: Production creator ecosystem platform streamlining digital media approvals, escrow billing, and asset versioning.

## Technical Skills
- **Languages**: Go, Python, Rust, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL, C++, Java
- **Frameworks & Libs**: Next.js, React, React Native, FastAPI, Gin, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- **Data & Distributed Systems**: Apache Iceberg, DuckDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Supabase, Docker, AWS, Kafka, Hedera Hashgraph
- **AI & Vision**: Edge AI, Model Quantization, YOLO-World, OpenCV, RAG, Context Engines, Prompt Engineering

## Photography
- **Unsplash Portfolio**: Over 700,000+ views and 10,000+ downloads worldwide focusing on architectural minimalism, landscape perspective, and urban textures.
